patent.title: Systems and methods for integration of microfluidic tear collection and lateral flow analysis of analytes of interest
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-1 (international R0). Do not map via older TearLab osmolarity patents (e.g. US7810380).

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout INT-1; corporate RD assumed.

technology.problem: Analyze very small tear volumes for osmolarity and/or analytes.
technology.mechanism: Microfluidic substrate with sample region(s) and passive valves enabling osmolarity transduction and/or metered transfer to lateral-flow / analyte detection region.

value_carriers.name: TearLab Osmolarity System (candidate; osmolarity-only cleared product)
value_carriers.description: Same assignee family. Cleared product measures tear osmolarity; does not publicly practice lateral-flow analyte integration claimed by this grant. Claims check FAIL.

gaps.description: No public evidence commercial TearLab SKU practices this patent's LFA/analyte-integration claim elements.

notes: Holdout INT-1. T0=2026-10-13. Claims FAIL → R0. Product narrative ≠ this grant. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
